title: Sequencing: panel presentations
bodyMd:
Five panel presentations occupy five consecutive speaking slots. Each is delivered once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Harbour, Island, Library, Market, Park.

- Library must occur after Harbour and before Park.
- Island and Market must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.
- Harbour must not be in position 1.
